stories.headline: Intel Q1 Revenue Beats by 9% at $13.6B as Data Center Jumps 22% and Foundry Grows 16%

key_facts.fact: Intel Q1 2026 revenue was $13.58 billion, up 7.2% YoY and well above the $12.42 billion analyst estimate; adjusted EPS was $0.29 vs $0.01 expected
key_facts.excerpt: Intel's first-quarter revenue rose 7.2 percent from a year earlier to $13.58 billion, topping a forecast of $12.42 billion. Given that it posted revenue declines in 5 of the past 7 quarters, it was seen as a sign the trend is changing.

key_facts.fact: Data Center and AI segment revenue rose 22% YoY to $5.1 billion, driven by Xeon CPU demand and 10-15% server CPU price increases
key_facts.excerpt: Q1 2026 Data Center & AI revenue was $5.05bn, +22% YoY. Growth accelerated on stronger AI server CPU demand.

key_facts.fact: Intel Foundry revenue was $5.4 billion, up 16% YoY, though external foundry revenue was only about $170 million (~3% of total)
key_facts.excerpt: Q1 2026 foundry revenue was $5.42bn, +16% YoY. Intersegment eliminations totaled $5.25bn, implying external foundry revenue of about $170mn (~3%).

key_facts.fact: Q2 guidance of $13.8-14.8B revenue and $0.20 adjusted EPS exceeded analyst estimates of $13.07B and $0.09 respectively
key_facts.excerpt: Intel forecast second-quarter revenue of $13.8 billion to $14.8 billion and adjusted earnings per share of $0.20. That exceeded market forecasts of $13.07 billion in revenue and $0.09 in earnings per share.

key_facts.fact: Intel shares surged 15%+ after hours; the stock has risen more than 80% this year, with CEO Lip-Bu Tan citing the shift from foundational models to inference and agentic workloads as driving CPU demand
key_facts.excerpt: The next wave of AI will bring intelligence closer to the end user, moving from foundational models to inference to agentic. This shift is significantly increasing the need for Intel's CPUs and wafer and advanced packaging offerings.

key_facts.fact: Google signed a multi-year contract to use Xeon CPUs for AI inference and other workloads; latest PC and data-center chips are being produced on the 18A process at a new Arizona plant
key_facts.excerpt: Google later decided to use multiple generations of Intel CPUs to handle AI workloads at its data centers. The latest PC and data-center chips are being produced on an 18A process at a new plant in Arizona.

stories.headline: Huawei Says Ascend 950 SuperPod Fully Supports DeepSeek V4, Achieves 20ms Inference Latency

key_facts.fact: Huawei announced its entire Ascend SuperPod product line now supports the DeepSeek V4 series models, following the V4-Pro and V4-Flash open-source release
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei stated that Ascend has consistently supported the DeepSeek series models. Through close collaboration between the two parties' chip and model technologies, the entire Ascend SuperPod product line now supports the DeepSeek V4 series models.

key_facts.fact: The Ascend 950 SuperPod achieves low-latency inference of 20ms for DeepSeek V4-Pro and 10ms for DeepSeek V4-Flash, redefining performance ceiling for long context inference
key_facts.excerpt: The Ascend 950 SuperPod redefines the performance ceiling for long context inference, achieving low-latency inference of 20ms for DeepSeek V4-Pro and 10ms for DeepSeek V4-Flash.

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek V4-Pro has 1.6 trillion total parameters with 49 billion active, trained on 33 trillion tokens with a 1 million token context window, released under MIT license
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei Technologies said on Friday its Ascend supernode based on Ascend 950 AI chips would fully support Deepseek's V4 versions after the Chinese artificial intelligence startup launched a preview of its new model.

key_facts.fact: Alibaba, ByteDance, and Tencent have purchased hundreds of thousands of Ascend 950PR chips for cloud services to sell DeepSeek models; prices of the chip have risen 20% due to demand
key_facts.excerpt: 即将发布的DeepSeek-V4会完全适配于华为的昇腾950PR芯片，阿里、字节、腾讯等大厂已经采购了数十万颗这款芯片，用来提供给云服务以便销售DeepSeek模型。因为供需关系的变化，昇腾950PR芯片已经涨价20%

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek V4 also supports Cambricon chips as an alternative to Huawei's Ascend, diversifying China's domestic AI chip ecosystem
key_facts.excerpt: 出于分摊风险的考虑，DeepSeek-V4也适配了寒武纪的芯片

stories.headline: TerraPower Begins Construction on First Next-Gen Nuclear Plant in the US, a 345MW Natrium Reactor

key_facts.fact: TerraPower officially started construction on Kemmerer Unit 1 in Wyoming on April 23, the first utility-scale advanced nuclear power plant in the United States
key_facts.excerpt: TerraPower, a nuclear innovation company, today, announced the official start of construction on its flagship Natrium® plant, Kemmerer Unit 1. Kemmerer Unit 1 is on track to be the first utility-scale advanced nuclear power plant in the United States.

key_facts.fact: The NRC construction permit issued in March 2026 was the first for a commercial non-light water reactor in more than 40 years and the first for any commercial reactor in nearly a decade
key_facts.excerpt: The construction start follows the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission's (NRC's) issuance of a construction permit on March 4, 2026—the first the agency has granted for a commercial non–light water reactor in more than 40 years and the first for any commercial reactor in nearly a decade.

key_facts.fact: The Natrium plant features a 345MW sodium-cooled fast reactor with molten salt thermal storage that can boost output to 500MW for over 5 hours during peak demand
key_facts.excerpt: The facility includes a 345-megawatt, sodium-cooled fast reactor equipped with a system that captures excess heat within the molten salt. Tapping a thermal salt battery can boost the plant's power to 500 megawatts for more than five hours.

key_facts.fact: The project is backed by up to $2 billion in cost-shared federal support through DOE's Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program; founded by Bill Gates
key_facts.excerpt: Founded by Bill Gates and backed by up to $2 billion in cost-shared federal support through DOE's Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program (ARDP).

key_facts.fact: TerraPower aims for nuclear fission reactor operational by end of 2030; about 1,600 workers during construction and 250 permanent once operational
key_facts.excerpt: At peak construction, the project is expected to employ around 1,600 workers. Once operational, it is projected to support approximately 250 permanent jobs at the facility.

key_facts.fact: TerraPower already has an agreement with Meta to build 8 Natrium reactors in the US, with the first two intended to come online in 2032
key_facts.excerpt: In January, the company reached an agreement with Meta to build 8 Natrium reactors in the US, the first two of which are intended to come online in 2032.

stories.headline: Applied Digital Lands $7.5B 15-Year Lease for 300MW AI Data Center With US Hyperscaler

key_facts.fact: Applied Digital signed a 15-year lease with an unnamed US investment-grade hyperscaler for 300MW of capacity at its Delta Forge 1 campus, worth approximately $7.5 billion in total contracted value
key_facts.excerpt: This lease represents approximately $7.5 billion in total contracted value over an estimated 15-year lease term and covers 300 megawatts (MW) of critical IT load, purpose-built to support the hyperscaler's artificial intelligence (AI) and high-performance compute (HPC) infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: The deal expands Applied Digital's total contracted lease revenue to over $23 billion, with more than 50% now backed by investment-grade customers
key_facts.excerpt: This addition expands total contracted lease revenue to over $23 billion and further diversifies the company's customer base with a third hyperscale tenant. More than 50% of total contracted revenue is now backed by investment-grade customers.

key_facts.fact: Delta Forge 1 is a 430MW AI Factory campus in the southern United States designed for AI and high-performance computing workloads
key_facts.excerpt: The southern United States data center campus also positions Applied Digital to compete in the hyperscale cloud and AI compute segment alongside major infrastructure developers in North America. The leased capacity forms part of a 430 MW campus designed specifically for AI and high-performance computing workloads.

key_facts.fact: Applied Digital shares rose 9-14% intraday on the announcement, reflecting investor enthusiasm for long-term AI infrastructure demand
key_facts.excerpt: The announcement also triggered a sharp market reaction, with Applied Digital shares rising between 9% and 14% intraday, reflecting investor enthusiasm for long-term AI infrastructure demand and recurring revenue visibility.

stories.headline: Zhongji Innolight Breaks 1 Trillion Yuan Market Cap as AI Optical Module Demand Surges

key_facts.fact: Zhongji Innolight's stock crossed ¥900/share on April 23, pushing its market cap past the 1 trillion yuan (~$146B) mark and ranking 13th on the A-share market
key_facts.excerpt: 4月23日开盘,A股资本市场诞生了一个极具传奇色彩的里程碑:光模块龙头中际旭创(300308.SZ)股价涨至900元/股以上,市值突破万亿大关,在整个A股位列第13名

key_facts.fact: The stock surged over 12x in one year, from ¥66.86/share in March 2025 — the fastest journey from 100 billion to 1 trillion yuan market cap in A-share history
key_facts.excerpt: 中际旭创股价从2025年3月10日的66.86元/股开始一路狂飙,一年间翻超12倍,增速一骑绝尘,是A股历史上市值从千亿到万亿用时最短的企业

key_facts.fact: Q1 2026 revenue reached ¥19.5 billion ($2.7B), up 192% YoY, with net profit of ¥5.7 billion, up 262%
key_facts.excerpt: 2026年一季度再刷新增长纪录:一季度营收达到194.96亿元,增长192%;单季度净利润57.35亿元,同比增幅262.28%

key_facts.fact: Broker estimates indicate Zhongji Innolight holds roughly 80% of Nvidia's 1.6T optical module procurement and over 40% of the global 800G market
key_facts.excerpt: 中际旭创占据英伟达1.6T光模块采购量约80%份额,来自英伟达的订单约占公司总收入的60%...2025年,中际旭创在800G市场的占有率超过40%,全球排名第一

key_facts.fact: Morgan Stanley built a major position worth ¥3.7 billion in Q1 2026, entering the top-10 shareholders; Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and Temasek also invested
key_facts.excerpt: 2026年一季度,摩根士丹利大举建仓,持仓市值高达36.98亿元,进入前十大流通股东。此外,阿布扎比投资局、淡马锡等主权基金也通过其子公司参与了对中际旭创海外业务的直接注资

stories.headline: China's Pudu Robotics Raises ~$150M at $1.5B+ Valuation, Opens US HQ in Texas

key_facts.fact: Pudu Robotics raised nearly $150 million in a new funding round, bringing cumulative funding past $300 million and valuation above $1.5 billion
key_facts.excerpt: Pudu Robotics, a global leader in commercial service robotics, today announced that it has raised nearly USD 150 million in a new funding round. Following this round, the company's valuation has exceeded USD 1.5 billion.

key_facts.fact: The company achieved 100% year-over-year revenue growth in 2025, with commercial cleaning now representing over 70% of total revenue
key_facts.excerpt: This multi-sector approach resulted in a remarkable 100% year-over-year revenue surge in 2025. Notably, the company's commercial cleaning segment has grown to represent over 70% of total revenue.

key_facts.fact: Pudu holds 23% global market share in commercial service robotics according to Frost & Sullivan, ranking first worldwide; customers include Carrefour, Walmart, and EDEKA
key_facts.excerpt: According to Frost & Sullivan's 'Market Research on Global Commercial Service Robotics (2023)', Pudu Robotics commands a 23% global market share, ranking first worldwide.

key_facts.fact: Pudu relocated its US headquarters from Santa Clara to Richardson, Texas, with nearly 15,000 robots deployed across the Americas and ambitions to serve one million US users in five years
key_facts.excerpt: Pudu Robotics, a global leader in service robotics based in Shenzhen, China, will open its new U.S. headquarters in Richardson's Sherman Tech Center Thursday as part of a 'global strategic expansion.' With nearly 15,000 of its robots deployed across the Americas to date.

key_facts.fact: Industrial delivery robots saw rapid adoption with over 4,000 units shipped within one year of market launch; funds will accelerate embodied AI technologies and manufacturing capacity
key_facts.excerpt: Its industrial delivery robots have seen rapid adoption with over 4,000 units shipped within just one year of their market launch. Proceeds from the financing will be strategically deployed to accelerate the development of embodied AI technologies.

stories.headline: Nokia Q1 Profit Jumps 54% as Optical Networks for AI Data Centers Drive €1B in Hyperscaler Orders

key_facts.fact: Nokia's Q1 2026 comparable operating profit was €281 million, up 54% YoY; shares rose 7% in Helsinki to their highest level since 2010, up 63% year-to-date
key_facts.excerpt: Nokia's comparable operating profit for the first quarter was 281 million euros, up 54 percent from a year earlier. On the back of the strong results, its shares rose about 7 percent in Helsinki, reaching their highest level since 2010. The stock is up 63 percent this year.

key_facts.fact: Optical networks segment grew 20% in Q1, the fastest of all Nokia divisions; Nokia secured about €1 billion in new orders from hyperscalers including Amazon, Google, and Microsoft
key_facts.excerpt: Growth was led by optical networks within the network infrastructure division. That business grew 20 percent in the first quarter. Nokia secured about 1 billion euros of new orders from those customers in the first quarter.

key_facts.fact: Revenue exposure to AI and cloud customers expanded to 8% of total and rose 49% YoY as hyperscalers build large-scale AI training infrastructure
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue exposure to AI and cloud customers expanded to 8 percent and rose 49 percent from a year earlier.

key_facts.fact: Nokia raised its 2026 network infrastructure growth guidance from 6-8% to 12-14%, driven by optical and IP networks demand from AI customers
key_facts.excerpt: It increased its 2026 growth guidance for the network infrastructure division to 12 to 14 percent from 6 to 8 percent.

key_facts.fact: Nokia forecasts the AI and cloud-related network market will grow at a 27% CAGR through 2028, nearly double last year's forecast
key_facts.excerpt: Nokia forecast that the AI and cloud-related network market it supplies will grow at a compound annual rate of 27 percent through 2028. That is almost double the level of the forecast it presented last year.

sources.title: Nokia beats market expectations as fibre optic business for AI data centres lifts results
